observations.behavior: Adds a new series fingerprinting function and its use in histogram folding, while updating documentation and adding tests.
observations.code_quote: The service converts these component samples to one native histogram row when a request contains `_sum` and the `+Inf` bucket for the same label set and timestamp. The native row has `histogram_bounds` and `histogram_counts`. Its series fingerprint is the label fingerprint of an equivalent OTLP histogram, combined with the bound set. The storage keeps one bound set for each series and hour, so a partial bucket set and the complete bucket set of one histogram get separate series. Queries combine them by label set.
